report.clinical_summary: Patient presents with persistent fatigue for 6 months and enlarged lymph nodes in the neck. Fatigue is constant, impacting daily functioning and work productivity. Patient has tried lifestyle changes (sleep, exercise, stress reduction) but seen no improvement. Primary care doctor offered active surveillance for lymph nodes and lifestyle recommendations, but patient is frustrated by lack of concrete treatment plan. Patient is emotionally affected, experiencing frustration, anger, worry, and uncertainty. Patient is open to further testing and specialist referral but concerned about side effects, dependence, and long-term implications of medications.
